name: nucleoporin 98 and 96 precursor
pathways: positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome
post-transcriptional tethering of RNA polymerase II gene DNA at nuclear periphery

function.text: NUP98 encodes nuclear pore complex protein Nup98-Nup96 [Cleaved into: Nuclear pore complex protein Nup98; Nuclear pore complex protein Nup96]. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and molecular condensate scaffold activity. It participates in positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and post-transcriptional tethering of RNA polymerase II gene DNA at nuclear periphery.
